name: Particle Shader Sample
description: Sample for a mod's own particle hooks (ShaderBlock): a swirl of curl-noise particles moved by shaders/swirl.hlsl (linked into Kiln's sprite at start, every loop capped and no buffer in reach), the same block on Kiln's own sprite to compare, and one naming a hook module that fails its checks on purpose, which Kiln's sprite draws instead. Advanced: it runs its own code on the player's GPU.
